common_instruction: Use the stated context; explain concrete behavior and do not claim tests were run without evidence.

cases.name: Unwrap unit conversion
cases.prompt: Loki logs have a duration field like duration=1.5s in logfmt. A proposed latency query uses | unwrap duration | duration_seconds [5m] and returns a parse error. Give a valid p95-by-app LogQL expression and handle parse errors.
cases.trap: Treats duration_seconds as a pipeline stage after unwrap rather than the supported unwrap converter.
expectations: Uses unwrap duration_seconds(duration) in the unwrapped range expression.
Filters pipeline errors with __error__="" and preserves valid aggregation groupings.
must_not: Does not retain | duration_seconds as a stage.
